reasoning: This repository is the OpenDataHub (ODH) fork of kubeflow/kubeflow containing two Go-based Kubernetes controllers: (1) notebook-controller, the upstream Kubeflow Notebook controller that watches Notebook custom resources (kubeflow.org/v1) and reconciles them into StatefulSets and Services, and (2) odh-notebook-controller, an ODH extension controller that adds OpenShift-specific capabilities such as Gateway API routing, kube-rbac-proxy webhook injection, and DSPA secret management. Both controllers follow the standard Kubernetes operator pattern — they watch CRDs, reconcile desired state, and manage child resources. The repository includes CRD definitions, kustomize deployment overlays, and envtest-based test suites, all characteristic of a Kubernetes operator project.
